decision.initial_reason: Connecticut required 39 second-half points to clear 75.5 and showed strong positive shooting-regression indicators after a 3-for-17 second quarter and 2-for-14 first-half three-point shooting.
decision.pivot_trigger: CON team total moved from 75.5 to 77.5 while NYL team total remained 89.5, materially compressing the Connecticut edge while preserving the New York under edge.

notes: The original Connecticut Over 75.5 thesis was valid at the initial number but no longer met the same value threshold after the line moved two points to 77.5.
The NYL 89.5 team total did not move, leaving a 3.5-point gap versus the SharpEdge fair projection of 86.
This is a market-selection pivot, not a reversal of the original game-environment read.
The wager tests whether derivative repricing can identify the cleaner surviving edge after the preferred side is steamed away.
